material.description: A full-session CPU profile on the live page puts about 60 percent of samples in web_bg.wasm functions (sim tick work), which is gameplay cost rather than startup. Profile per tick, find the hottest sim functions, and reduce them without changing sim results. Witness: state_hash equal before and after over a fixed replay, and lower ms per tick.
material.subject: Sim wasm dominates CPU during play
material.witness: Live page with a hero picked: 314 ticks in 20.2s = 15.6 ticks/sec (the design rate), 90 samples, median frame cpuMs 1.9. Native release sim measured at ~0.031 ms/tick (slope 200->5200 ticks). The sim keeps pace and the frame is well inside a 16.7ms budget, so no per-tick reduction is justified. Stale.
